theorems.band_digit_bounds:
theorem band_digit_bounds (m c : Int) (hc : Phase m c) :
    1 ≤ c - m * bulkCarry m c ∧ c - m * bulkCarry m c < m
theorems.phase_step:
theorem phase_step (m c : Int) (hodd : ∃ r : Int, m = 2 * r + 1)
    (hc : Phase m c) : Phase m (nextPhase m c)
theorems.boundary_digit_bounds:
theorem boundary_digit_bounds (m c e : Int) (hc : Phase m c)
    (he : 0 ≤ e ∧ e ≤ 1) :
    0 ≤ c + e - (m + 1) * bulkCarry m c ∧
      c + e - (m + 1) * bulkCarry m c ≤ m
theorems.normalize_digits_bounded:
theorem normalize_digits_bounded (m : Int) (B : Word) (e : Int) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    ∀ x ∈ (normalize m B e).1, 0 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ m
theorems.zip_add_bounded:
theorem zip_add_bounded (m : Int) (a b : Word)
    (ha : ∀ x ∈ a, 0 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ m)
    (hb : ∀ x ∈ b, 0 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ m) :
    Bounded m (List.zipWith (· + ·) a b)
theorems.append_digit_bounded:
theorem append_digit_bounded (m : Int) (w : Word) (e : Int)
    (hw : ∀ x ∈ w, 0 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ m) (he : 0 ≤ e ∧ e ≤ m) :
    ∀ x ∈ w ++ [e], 0 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ m
theorems.rawExterior_bounded:
theorem rawExterior_bounded (m c : Int) (B : Word) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hc : Phase m c) (hB : Bounded m B) : Bounded m (rawExterior m c B)
theorems.stripSuffix_bounded:
theorem stripSuffix_bounded (m c : Int) (B : Word) (hB : Bounded m B) :
    Bounded m (stripSuffix c B).1
theorems.nextExterior_bounded:
theorem nextExterior_bounded (m c : Int) (B : Word) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hc : Phase m c) (hB : Bounded m B) : Bounded m (nextExterior m c B)
theorems.valid_step:
theorem valid_step (m : Int) (s : State) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hodd : ∃ r : Int, m = 2 * r + 1) (hs : Valid m s) :
    Valid m (step m s)
theorems.valid_orbit:
theorem valid_orbit (m : Int) (s : State) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hodd : ∃ r : Int, m = 2 * r + 1) (hs : Valid m s) (n : Nat) :
    Valid m (orbit m s n)
theorems.overflow_bit_orbit:
theorem overflow_bit_orbit (m : Int) (s : State) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hodd : ∃ r : Int, m = 2 * r + 1) (hs : Valid m s) (n : Nat) :
    exteriorOverflow m (orbit m s n).c (orbit m s n).B = 0 ∨
      exteriorOverflow m (orbit m s n).c (orbit m s n).B = 1
theorems.orbit_add:
theorem orbit_add (m : Int) (s : State) (a b : Nat) :
    orbit m s (a + b) = orbit m (orbit m s a) b
theorems.residue_zero_orbit:
theorem residue_zero_orbit (m : Int) (s : State) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hodd : ∃ r : Int, m = 2 * r + 1) (hs : Valid m s)
    (hz : residue m s = 0) (n : Nat) : residue m (orbit m s n) = 0
theorems.residue_zero_after_overflow:
theorem residue_zero_after_overflow (m : Int) (s : State) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hodd : ∃ r : Int, m = 2 * r + 1) (hs : Valid m s) (j n : Nat)
    (hg : exteriorOverflow m (orbit m s j).c (orbit m s j).B = 1) :
    residue m (orbit m s (j + 1 + n)) = 0
theorems.decimal_valid_orbit:
theorem decimal_valid_orbit (s : State) (hs : Valid 9 s) (n : Nat) :
    Valid 9 (orbit 9 s n)
theorems.decimal_residue_after_overflow:
theorem decimal_residue_after_overflow (s : State) (hs : Valid 9 s) (j n : Nat)
    (hg : exteriorOverflow 9 (orbit 9 s j).c (orbit 9 s j).B = 1) :
    Moment.moment (orbit 9 s (j + 1 + n)).c
      (orbit 9 s (j + 1 + n)).B % 22 = 0

theorems.normalize_append:
theorem normalize_append (m : Int) (a b : Word) (e : Int) :
    normalize m (a ++ b) e =
      ((normalize m a e).1 ++ (normalize m b (normalize m a e).2).1,
        (normalize m b (normalize m a e).2).2)
theorems.normalize_reverse_cons:
theorem normalize_reverse_cons (m x : Int) (xs : Word) (e : Int) :
    normalize m (x :: xs).reverse e =
      ((normalize m xs.reverse e).1 ++
        [(x + (normalize m xs.reverse e).2) % (m + 1)],
        (x + (normalize m xs.reverse e).2) / (m + 1))
theorems.headD_append_replicate:
theorem headD_append_replicate (c : Int) (B : Word) (n : Nat) :
    (B ++ List.replicate n c).headD c = B.headD c
theorems.headD_stripSuffix:
theorem headD_stripSuffix (c : Int) (B : Word) :
    (stripSuffix c B).1.headD c = B.headD c
theorems.head_step_raw:
theorem head_step_raw (m : Int) (s : State) :
    head (step m s) = (rawExterior m s.c s.B).headD (nextPhase m s.c)
theorems.raw_head_nil:
theorem raw_head_nil (m c : Int) :
    (rawExterior m c []).headD (nextPhase m c) =
      if bulkCarry m c = 0 then 2 * c else c - m
theorems.raw_head_cons_no_overflow:
theorem raw_head_cons_no_overflow (m c x : Int) (xs : Word)
    (hg : exteriorOverflow m c (x :: xs) = 0) :
    (rawExterior m c (x :: xs)).headD (nextPhase m c) =
      x % (m + 1) +
        (x + (normalize m xs.reverse (bulkCarry m c)).2) % (m + 1)
theorems.raw_head_cons_overflow:
theorem raw_head_cons_overflow (m c x : Int) (xs : Word)
    (hg : exteriorOverflow m c (x :: xs) ≠ 0) :
    (rawExterior m c (x :: xs)).headD (nextPhase m c) = x % (m + 1) + 1
theorems.head_no_overflow:
theorem head_no_overflow (m : Int) (s : State) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hs : Valid m s) (hg : exteriorOverflow m s.c s.B = 0) :
    head s ≤ m ∧ 2 * head s ≤ head (step m s)
theorems.head_positive_step:
theorem head_positive_step (m : Int) (s : State) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hs : Valid m s) (hp : 0 < head s) : 0 < head (step m s)
theorems.head_positive_orbit:
theorem head_positive_orbit (m : Int) (s : State) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hodd : ∃ r : Int, m = 2 * r + 1) (hs : Valid m s)
    (hp : 0 < head s) (n : Nat) : 0 < head (orbit m s n)
theorems.head_powTwo_lower_bound:
theorem head_powTwo_lower_bound (m : Int) (s : State) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hodd : ∃ r : Int, m = 2 * r + 1) (hs : Valid m s)
    (hp : 0 < head s) (n : Nat)
    (hg : ∀ j : Nat, j < n →
      exteriorOverflow m (orbit m s j).c (orbit m s j).B = 0) :
    powTwo n ≤ head (orbit m s n)
theorems.overflow_by_power_bound:
theorem overflow_by_power_bound (m : Int) (s : State) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hodd : ∃ r : Int, m = 2 * r + 1) (hs : Valid m s)
    (hp : 0 < head s) (H : Nat) (hH : m < powTwo H) :
    ∃ j : Nat, j ≤ H ∧
      exteriorOverflow m (orbit m s j).c (orbit m s j).B = 1
theorems.decimal_overflow_before_five:
theorem decimal_overflow_before_five (s : State) (hs : Valid 9 s)
    (hp : 0 < head s) :
    ∃ j : Nat, j < 5 ∧ exteriorOverflow 9 (orbit 9 s j).c (orbit 9 s j).B = 1
theorems.overflow_in_every_window:
theorem overflow_in_every_window (m : Int) (s : State) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hodd : ∃ r : Int, m = 2 * r + 1) (hs : Valid m s)
    (hp : 0 < head s) (H start : Nat) (hH : m < powTwo H) :
    ∃ j : Nat, start ≤ j ∧ j ≤ start + H ∧
      exteriorOverflow m (orbit m s j).c (orbit m s j).B = 1
theorems.decimal_overflow_every_five:
theorem decimal_overflow_every_five (s : State) (hs : Valid 9 s)
    (hp : 0 < head s) (start : Nat) :
    ∃ j : Nat, start ≤ j ∧ j < start + 5 ∧
      exteriorOverflow 9 (orbit 9 s j).c (orbit 9 s j).B = 1
theorems.decimal_overflows_arbitrarily_late:
theorem decimal_overflows_arbitrarily_late (s : State) (hs : Valid 9 s)
    (hp : 0 < head s) (N : Nat) :
    ∃ j : Nat, N ≤ j ∧
      exteriorOverflow 9 (orbit 9 s j).c (orbit 9 s j).B = 1
theorems.residue_zero_from_power_bound:
theorem residue_zero_from_power_bound (m : Int) (s : State) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hodd : ∃ r : Int, m = 2 * r + 1) (hs : Valid m s)
    (hp : 0 < head s) (H : Nat) (hH : m < powTwo H) (n : Nat) :
    residue m (orbit m s (H + 1 + n)) = 0
theorems.decimal_residue_zero_from_five:
theorem decimal_residue_zero_from_five (s : State) (hs : Valid 9 s)
    (hp : 0 < head s) (n : Nat) :
    Moment.moment (orbit 9 s (5 + n)).c (orbit 9 s (5 + n)).B % 22 = 0
theorems.sharpStart_valid: theorem sharpStart_valid : Valid 9 sharpStart ∧ 0 < head sharpStart
theorems.sharp_no_earlier_overflow:
theorem sharp_no_earlier_overflow :
    ∀ j : Fin 4, exteriorOverflow 9 (orbit 9 sharpStart j.val).c
      (orbit 9 sharpStart j.val).B = 0
theorems.sharpAbsorptionStart_valid:
theorem sharpAbsorptionStart_valid :
    Valid 9 sharpAbsorptionStart ∧ 0 < head sharpAbsorptionStart
